question: What claim about the extent and origin of this Kaula teaching is at stake in describing it as ten crores in measure and supremely arisen?
premises: It is described as ten crores in measure.
It is described as supremely arisen.
inference: This Kaula teaching is presented as vast in measure and as having a supreme origin.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching is indeed ten crores in measure and supremely arisen.
